vars.description: Custom variables available for ${VAR} substitution in every field, taking precedence over any environment variable of the same name.

OnError.description: Behavior when this operation fails. abort: stop the whole feature immediately. abort-entry: for user-scoped entries, skip remaining users for this entry and continue to the next entry (equivalent to 'continue' for non-user-scoped entries). continue: log and proceed to the next operation/user; counts as an overall failure (non-zero exit). ignore: suppress the error and proceed as if it succeeded; does not affect the overall exit code.

Backup.description: Whether to back up the pre-existing file/directory before this operation overwrites or deletes it. 'auto': back up outside devcontainers, skip inside (detected via REMOTE_CONTAINERS/CODESPACES env vars). 'true': always back up. 'false': never back up. Always a string, never a YAML boolean, to avoid ambiguity with 'auto'. Only valid on create and delete entries — the feature-level backup/backup_dir options are the fallback when omitted.

IfExists.description: Behavior when dest already exists. skip: leave it untouched, no error. fail: abort this entry with an error. overwrite: force the operation regardless (semantics vary by op — see the op's own description).

IfNotExists.description: Behavior when a required path (dest for delete/chmod, src for move) does not exist. skip: silently succeed / no-op. fail: abort this entry with an error.

IfNotFound.description: Where to act when a location (inject's block, or its anchor line) cannot be found in the file. end_of_file: append there. beginning_of_file: prepend there. fail: abort this entry with an error. Reused for both if_not_found (block absent) and anchor_not_found (anchor line absent) since both share the same three outcomes.

Marker.description: A begin/end marker for the inject operation. A plain string is matched literally (exact line equality) and written as-is. An object separates the match pattern (an extended regex, ERE) used to locate an existing block from the literal text written when the block is first created — required together, since a match-only marker leaves the feature unable to know what to write.

oneOf.description: Literal marker text, used for both matching (exact line equality) and writing.

match.description: Extended regex (ERE) matched against whole lines to locate an existing marker.

text.description: Literal text written when the block is created (first run) or when rewrite_markers is true.

Anchor.description: Where to insert an inject block the first time it's created (i.e. no existing block found). A plain string (or the object's 'match') is an ERE matched against whole lines; the block is inserted immediately after (default) or before the first matching line. If omitted, if_not_found controls placement instead.

oneOf.description: ERE matched against whole lines; block inserted after the first match.

position.description: Insert the block after (default) or before the matched line.

CommonFields.description: Fields valid on every entry regardless of op. 'backup' is deliberately NOT here — it only applies to create/delete and is rejected as a mistake if set on other ops (enforced via Entry's unevaluatedProperties, exactly like if_exists on inject/delete/chmod).

dest.description: Destination path. Absolute, or ~/ / ${HOME}/ prefixed for user-scoped entries. Supports ${VAR} substitution. Bare relative paths are rejected at runtime.

chmod.description: Permission mode applied after the operation, e.g. '644', '755', 'u+x'. Not meaningful for delete/inject.

owner.description: Owning user applied after the operation, e.g. 'root', '${USERNAME}'. Not meaningful for delete/inject.

group.description: Owning group applied after the operation. Not meaningful for delete/inject.

strict_vars.description: Whether an undefined ${VAR} reference in this entry's fields is a hard error (true, default) or expands to empty string (false).

users.description: For user-scoped entries (dest starting with ~/ or ${HOME}/): explicit list of usernames (or the 'all' keyword) to apply this entry to, overriding the feature-level default user list. Rejected as a validation error if set on a system-scoped (absolute, non-home) dest.

Defaults.description: Global fallback values merged into every entry at runtime, before the entry's op is dispatched. A field here that doesn't apply to a given entry's op is harmless: the merge happens AFTER schema validation of the raw manifest, so e.g. a global 'if_exists: skip' default silently has no effect on inject entries (which never read it) rather than causing a validation error. Only fields EXPLICITLY written on an entry whose op doesn't support them are rejected.

leading_newline.description: inject default: ensure a newline precedes the block on insertion.

trailing_newline.description: inject default: ensure a newline follows the block on insertion.

rewrite_markers.description: inject default: also rewrite marker lines (using their 'text' value) when updating an existing block.

recursive.description: delete/chmod default: operate recursively on directory trees.

recursive_attrs.description: mkdir default: apply chmod/owner/group to newly created intermediate directories, not just the final one.

preserve_perms.description: create default: when src is a local path, copy its permissions/ownership to dest.

follow_symlinks.description: create (directory-tree copy) default: follow symlinks encountered in src.

FetchAuth.description: Authentication for remote src: fetches, resolved when the operation runs (not at manifest-parse time). Values support ${VAR} substitution so lifecycle-stage entries can reference env vars available at that stage (e.g. a token exported earlier in the container's lifecycle) instead of only build-time credentials. Falls back to the feature-level fetch_headers/fetch_netrc options when omitted — meaningful only at build time, since those options aren't propagated to lifecycle scripts.

fetch_headers.description: HTTP headers as 'Name: value' strings, applied when src is fetched.

fetch_netrc.description: Path to a .netrc file for src authentication.

OpCreate.description: Write dest from inline content, a local/remote src file, or (when src is a local directory) recursively copy a directory tree. if_exists controls the conflict when dest already exists (files) or per-file within the tree (directories).

src.description: Source: local path, URI, or local directory path (for a recursive tree copy). Mutually exclusive with content.

content.description: Inline content. Mutually exclusive with src.

preserve_perms.description: When src is a local path, copy its permissions/ownership to dest.

include.description: Directory-tree copy only: glob pattern(s) of files to include, relative to src. Default **/* (all files).

exclude.description: Directory-tree copy only: glob pattern(s) of files to exclude.

follow_symlinks.description: Directory-tree copy only: follow symlinks encountered in src.

OpInject.description: Insert or idempotently update a named, marker-delimited block inside dest. Always updates an existing block in place; there is no 'skip if exists' mode (use create with if_exists:skip for install-once semantics instead). Creates dest if it doesn't exist.

src.description: Source for the block content: local path or URI. Mutually exclusive with content.

content.description: Inline block content. Mutually exclusive with src.

leading_newline.description: On insertion, ensure a newline precedes begin_marker if the preceding content doesn't already end with one.

trailing_newline.description: On insertion, ensure a newline follows end_marker.

rewrite_markers.description: When updating an existing block, also rewrite the marker lines themselves using their 'text' value.

OpDelete.description: Remove dest. Silently succeeds if dest does not exist (unless if_not_exists:fail).

recursive.description: Required (true) to delete a non-empty directory; otherwise the entry fails with an explicit error.

backup.description: Back up dest before deleting it, enabling restore on uninstall.

OpSymlink.description: Create a symlink at dest pointing to src.

src.description: Symlink target. Relative (resolved relative to dest's parent, as in POSIX ln -s) or absolute.

OpMkdir.description: Create dest and any missing parent directories (mkdir -p semantics).

if_exists.description: overwrite here means: create if missing, and also apply chmod/owner/group to an already-existing dest.

recursive_attrs.description: Apply chmod/owner/group to newly created intermediate directories too, not just dest itself. Has no effect on directories that already existed.

OpChmod.description: Change permissions/ownership on an existing path without altering its content. At least one of chmod, owner, group is required.

recursive.description: Apply recursively to a directory tree.

src.description: Local filesystem path to move (absolute or ~/-relative). URIs are not valid here.

if_exists.description: Behavior when dest already exists. Defaults to fail (not skip like other ops) since an unintended destructive rename is the primary risk.

if_not_exists.description: Behavior when src does not exist.

OpTouch.description: Create dest if absent, or update its mtime if present. Never modifies content. chmod/owner/group (if set) are always applied regardless of if_exists.

if_exists.description: Deliberately defaults to overwrite (bump mtime every run), unlike every other op's skip default — touch's primary use case is a 'last ran' marker file. Set to skip explicitly for create-once semantics.

Entry.description: One file operation. The concrete shape (required/allowed fields) depends on 'op'.
